offseason.note: Apr-Oct 2003-2026 ECCC daily means, n=5083; cabin heating zero; AC not modeled

grid_cost_note: NREL/industry depot grid-upgrade range 100-300 $/kW; Toronto Hydro: project-specific capital contribution, no public schedule
ffh_om_note: assumption: annual burner service; CALSTART FFH white paper (2021) documents fuel use only; sweep 500-2000
el_heater_note: p99 of eHeat energy / electric-heating time over 9,001 telemetry runs
traction_v7_note: route-mean x band-factor interface; R52 mean from Jan-Mar 2025 winter (temporal split); factors from full fleet
ffh_nominal_note: manufacturer heat flow, Valeo Thermo+ 350 (New Flyer); useful output = phi(T) x nominal, Liu et al. (Paper 1, rev. Aug 2026)
cost_v9_note: v9 (2026-11-05): cost parameters aligned with Liu et al. (Applied Energy, in press), Table C.1. Demand charge: Toronto Hydro General Service 50-999 kW, effective 2026-01-01: 10.5170 CAD/kVA / 0.98 PF + 4.4306 network + 2.8938 connection = 18.06 CAD/kW-month. Mass penalty: 118 kWh / 165 Wh/kg = 715 kg on a 13,500 kg curb (5.3%) x elasticity 0.7 = +3.7% traction. Charger cost points: Manzolli et al. 2025 (Sustainable Futures), Charger C = 120 kW for 160 kCAD (v8 used 160 kW).

eccc_v9.source: ECCC climate-daily API, Toronto City (CLIMATE_IDENTIFIER 6158355), daily MEAN_TEMPERATURE
eccc_v9.winters: 2002-03 to 2025-26 (24 winters), Nov 1 - Mar 31, each winter's counts scaled to 151 days to absorb missing days
eccc_v9.v8_note: v8 used two-winter counts (45/45/36/19/6) that cannot be reproduced from the ECCC daily means of those winters

energy_price_note: Energy price = 0.12 CAD/kWh commodity level of Liu et al. (Applied Energy, in press, Table C.1) plus the hourly deviation of the IESO HOEP from its seasonal mean (weekdays; winter Nov 2024-Mar 2025, off-season Apr-Oct 2024; hour index = hour starting). The Global Adjustment is flat across hours, so only the wholesale component varies within the day.
